result.title: 再生能源發電量月資料
result.description:
1.資料內涵：我國當月呈現慣常水力、地熱、太陽光電、風力（陸域、離岸）、生質能（固態、氣態）及廢棄物發電技術產生之再生能源毛發電量統計資料。
2.收集目的：做為我國能源相關政策規劃與管理之依據。
3.收集方式：
(1)慣常水力、地熱、太陽光電、風力：記錄各類發電技術毛發電量，來自發電業、自用發電設備、售電業（躉購第三型再生能源發電設備）業者申報統計值。
(2)生質能及廢棄物：記錄自用發電設備用於發電燃料投入之生質能與廢棄物數量，來自自用發電設備業者申報之燃料使用量，並經燃料攤提公式計算而得。

en.title: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Bureau of Energy_ Monthly data on renewable energy generation
en.description: 1. Data content: Statistics on the gross generation of renewable energy generated from conventional hydro, geothermal, solar photovoltaic, wind (onshore, offshore), biomass (solid, gaseous), and waste-to-energy technologies in our country in the month.2. Collection purpose: As a basis for the planning and management of energy-related policies in our country.3. Collection methods:(1) Conventional hydro, geothermal, solar photovoltaic, and wind power: Record the gross generation of various power generation technologies, reported by power generation companies, self-use power generation equipment, and power selling companies (purchasing from type III renewable energy power generation equipment) operators.(2) Biomass and waste-to-energy: Record the quantity of biomass and waste used as fuel for self-use power generation equipment, derived from the reported fuel usage by self-use power generation equipment operators and calculated using fuel cost allocation formulas.
